summary: Open-source, self-hosted customer support desk with live chat, email and social inboxes, an alternative to Intercom and Zendesk.
whatItDoes: Chatwoot is a customer support platform that puts conversations from website live chat, email, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS and more into one shared inbox. It also has a help center portal and an AI agent called Captain.
problem: Support teams juggle many channels and often hand their customer data to a hosted tool. Chatwoot gathers every channel in one inbox and can be self-hosted so you keep control of the data.
whoFor: Support teams looking for an Intercom or Zendesk alternative
Businesses that want to self-host their help desk
Teams that answer customers on chat, email and social apps
whyChoose: It is open source and self-hosted, gives you full control over customer data, and covers inbox, help center, reports and automation in one product.
requirements: A server or a hosting platform such as Heroku or DigitalOcean
Environment variables set as described in the Chatwoot docs
overview: Chatwoot is an open-source, self-hosted customer support platform. It centralises customer conversations into one inbox, whether they start in live chat on your website, email, Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, WhatsApp, Telegram, Line or SMS.
Captain, Chatwoot's AI agent, can answer common questions and automate responses so your team can focus on harder conversations. A built-in Help Center Portal lets you publish articles and FAQs.
Teams get private notes and @mentions, labels, canned responses, auto-assignment, business hours and automation, plus conversation, agent, inbox, team and CSAT reports.
